prompts.title: Casual White Shirt Man Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image strictly for accurate face/identity matching. Preserve the exact facial identity, facial structure of the reference person.
Create a photorealistic cinematic lifestyle portrait of a handsome man sitting beside a large wooden-framed window in a cozy, elegant interior. He has soft, naturally styled hair, refined facial features, clear natural skin, and a calm, thoughtful expression. His head is turned slightly toward the window as he gazes outside, with a relaxed, introspective mood.
He is wearing a loose, oversized white cotton button-up shirt, with the top buttons casually undone, revealing part of his upper chest. The shirt has natural wrinkles and soft fabric texture. He sits in a relaxed pose, with his left arm resting casually on the window ledge and his hand hanging naturally, while his other arm rests comfortably by his side.
Warm golden-hour sunlight streams through the window from the left, softly illuminating his face, hair, neck, and white shirt while creating beautiful natural highlights and gentle shadows. The background features a warm, sophisticated interior with subtle framed artwork and dark furniture, kept softly out of focus. Outside the window, lush green foliage appears as creamy golden bokeh.
Composition: vertical 4:5 portrait, medium/upper-body framing, subject positioned centered, eye-level camera angle, natural candid pose, shallow depth of field, creamy background bokeh.
Photography: 85mm lens, f/1.8, soft cinematic depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural color grading, warm golden tones, subtle filmic contrast, soft atmospheric glow, premium editorial photography, highly detailed, ultra-realistic, cinematic lighting, 8K quality. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Cinematic Night Glow Restyle
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the main base image and preserve the subject’s original pose, framing, composition, camera angle, crop, body position, hand placement, facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, and overall subject details. Keep the aspect ratio the same as the original image. Do not change the pose or expression. Only transform the lighting, background mood, and atmosphere.
Convert the scene into a dark, moody nighttime portrait with a deep muted background fading into near-black shadows. Replace the original background with a soft, out-of-focus night environment featuring faint silhouettes, subtle bokeh lights, and cinematic dusk-to-night tones. Add a strong backlight directly behind the subject to create a bright white rim light around the hair, shoulders, arms, hands, clothing edges, and full body outline. Add a soft luminous bloom aura around the subject, especially around the outer edges, to create a dreamy glowing silhouette effect. The glow should feel natural, atmospheric, and cinematic, not overly artificial or neon.
Keep the subject clearly visible while allowing the background to remain dark and subdued. Maintain realistic skin texture, realistic clothing texture, and natural facial features. The final image should feel like an ultra-realistic editorial night portrait shot with an 85mm DSLR lens using soft flash diffusion, with shallow depth of field, subtle halation, bloom glow, gentle flash-lit contrast, and a dreamy low-light atmosphere.
Style keywords: cinematic rim light, glowing body aura, halation effect, bloom glow, dreamy silhouette glow, moody night portrait, soft flash diffusion, dusk bokeh background, CCD camera aesthetic, disposable flash mood, Instagram lofi night tones, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 4K.

prompts.title: Instagram Flash Restyle
prompts.prompt:
Apply only an Instagram Flash filter-style effect to the uploaded image. Do not regenerate, redesign, crop, reframe, beautify, retouch, or change any content. Preserve the exact same person, face, expression, pose, outfit, hairstyle, objects, background, framing, and composition. Change only the filter treatment: night conversion, direct flash behavior, color grading, visible noise, and film grain.
Convert the image into a darker night-like / low-light version of the same scene. Make the environment cooler, moodier, and richer, with a strong green-cyan / teal ambience and deeper night density, while keeping the original scene recognizable. The background should become darker and cooler than the subject, but not muddy or fully black.
The subject treatment is critical: light the subject with a strong direct on-camera frontal flash that is clearly visible in the result. The flash must dominate the subject more than the ambient light. The face, skin, hair, and clothing facing the camera should look brighter, flatter, more directly flash-lit, and slightly lifted in exposure. The subject should appear more illuminated and more separated from the surroundings, like a real camera-flash snapshot, not a softly relit portrait. Keep the skin warm, bright, glowing, and flash-washed, while the surroundings stay cooler and darker.
If reflective, glossy, metallic, leather, glass, polished, or shiny surfaces are present, show realistic small flash reflections / specular pops where appropriate. If the scene geometry naturally allows it, include a believable subtle hard-edged flash shadow behind the subject or nearby objects, but only where it would occur naturally.
Match the overall look of a rich Instagram Flash-style photo: stronger night mood, cooler green-cyan ambience, brighter flash-lit subject, slightly punchier contrast, and a more obvious filtered look. Add visible digital noise and fine 35mm color-negative film grain across the whole image. Keep the noise and grain clearly visible, especially in darker areas, smooth surfaces, and the background. If the original image already contains noise or compression texture, do not clean it up — blend it naturally into the overall grain structure.
The final result should look like the same original photo captured at night with a strong direct camera flash, featuring richer green-cyan ambience, a much more obviously flash-lit subject, visible film grain, visible noise, and a filtered Instagram Flash look.
Avoid: soft studio lighting, weak flash on the subject, polished portrait lighting, over-clean denoising, overly neutral colors, dull flat skin, muddy blacks, or changing the image content.

prompts.title: Blurry to 4K AI Upscale
prompts.prompt:
Enhance the portrait while preserving the subject’s exact identity.

Maintain accurate facial structure, proportions, and natural features. Do not alter face shape, expression, or identity. Only apply subtle cleanup to improve clarity while keeping the person fully recognizable.
Keep the original background exactly as it is. Do not replace, modify, or add anything. The environment, framing, and composition must remain unchanged.
Recreate the image with a premium full-frame camera look, similar to a Sony A1 with an 85mm f/1.4 lens. Use shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the face and smooth natural background blur. Maintain realistic lens behavior and natural perspective.
Match the original lighting direction and mood, then refine it into a cinematic, subject-focused look. Use soft directional light with gentle contrast, controlled highlights, and clean shadows. Avoid harsh lighting or artificial glow.
Maintain natural skin texture with fine detail. Avoid over-smoothing or plastic appearance. Use balanced color tones with a subtle cinematic contrast and realistic saturation.
Output should feel like a high-end editorial portrait with improved clarity, depth, and tonal range, while keeping the original scene and identity fully intact.

Negative constraints:
Do not change background.
Do not alter face or expression.
No artificial glow or over-processing.
No unrealistic lighting.
No skin smoothing or texture loss.

prompts.title: Old Photo Restoration
prompts.prompt:
SUBJECT
Identity Lock: Absolute preservation of facial geometry and body proportions; Identity Similarity Threshold $\ge 0.95$.
Epidermal Fidelity: Execute macro-level epidermal texture synthesis to avoid "plastic" smoothing. Restore natural material skin-pore structures, textile weaves, and era-specific surfaces.
Classification & Damage: Autonomous Origin Detection (Real/Synthetic/Ambiguous). Apply DamageScore (0–100) and RegionConfidence (RC).
RC $\ge 70$: Context-guided high-detail reconstruction.
RC 30–69: Coarse-to-medium structural restoration; zero semantic invention.
RC $< 30$: Era-consistent silhouette/texture fill only.
Safe Reconstruction Logic: Area-based constraints: $< 10\%$ (Guided inpainting), $10\text{--}40\%$ (Structural geometry synthesis), $> 40\%$ (Texture-only pass).
COMPOSITION
Frame Integrity: Strict adherence to original aspect ratio, framing, and semantic positioning. No object injection or removal.
Perspective & Scale: Enforce rigorous vanishing point alignment and geometric continuity.
Spatial Physics: Validate structural synthesis against surrounding geometry to ensure physical plausibility. Revert to "Safe Fill" if PhysicsCheck fails.
LIGHTING
Global Illumination: Restore Chiaroscuro-level lighting depth while maintaining consistent shadow direction and luminance gradients.
Material Reflectance: Physically accurate reconstruction of light interaction with surfaces (specular highlights, matte finishes).
Chromatic Consistency: Restore faded tones to era-correct palettes with modern High Dynamic Range (HDR). Maintain vintage warmth/analog character through spectral-aware color fidelity.
TECHNICAL SPECS
Restoration Pipeline: Sub-pixel deconvolution, motion-blur neutralization, and chromatic aberration correction.
Super-Resolution: Execute Multi-stage 4x+ Super-Resolution with an anti-artifact refinement pass.
Noise Management: Intelligent separation of sensor noise vs. compression artifacts; preserve original analog grain structure while removing degradational "noise."
Output Parameters: Lossless 16-bit PNG/TIFF; Archival and sRGB color space integration; Metadata/EXIF preservation. Zero watermarks/logos/identifying marks altered.
